北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京天气晴朗但体感很冷，注意添衣保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels very cold. Remember to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，气温 12℃，体感舒适。外出散步记得带伞哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with a comfortable 12℃. Take an umbrella if you go out for a stroll.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，气温 11℃。天气略干燥，记得补水哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy with 11℃. It's a bit dry, remember to hydrate!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温 19℃ 舒适。尽情享受这温暖吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and a comfortable 19℃. Enjoy this warmth to the fullest!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳暖暖的 20℃，阳光正好。美好的一天，开心地度过哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is a warm 20℃ with perfect sunshine. Have a wonderful day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感稍凉，记得适时加件衣服哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels a bit cool. Remember to add a layer of clothing!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光正好，气温 11℃。午间暖和，早晚注意保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny with 11℃. Warm at noon, but stay warm in the mornings and evenings.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 11℃。湿度稍高，带伞更安心哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with a comfortable 11℃. Humidity is a bit high, an umbrella brings peace of mind.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗，气温 13℃，体感舒适。享受阳光好时光吧！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny with a comfortable 13℃. Enjoy the beautiful sunshine!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 3℃，略有凉意。记得多喝水，防干燥。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels 3℃, a bit chilly. Remember to drink more water to prevent dryness.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，能见度不高。出行请注意安全，小心驾驶。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy with low visibility. Please drive safely and be careful when going out.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨大雾且严寒，体感-11℃。务必裹严实，注意保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is very cold and foggy, feels -11℃. Be sure to bundle up warmly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 -2℃。风力稍大，出门记得戴帽子哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels -2℃. It's a bit windy, remember to wear a hat when you go out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 9℃。风力不小，小心着凉哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels 9℃. The wind is noticeable, be careful not to catch a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阳光灿烂 17℃，风力稍大。外出记得防风哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny at 17℃ with some wind. Remember to shield yourself from the wind when going out!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阳光正好，体感 4℃。风力有点大，注意防风。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny and feels 4℃. It's a bit windy, remember to protect yourself from the wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 0℃。风力大，务必多穿衣物防风保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels 0℃. It's very windy, be sure to wear more clothes to stay warm and protected from the wind!
